about.subtitle: Where Vietnamese precision artistry meets Australian luxury standards.
about.storyTitle: 8+ Years of Nail Perfection in Sydney CBD
about.storyP1: Founded in 2018 in the vibrant heart of Sydney, Glamour Nails & Spa was born with a single mission: to elevate nail care into an uncompromising ritual of beauty, safety, and wellness.
about.storyP2: Our salon brings together the legendary dexterity and patience of Vietnamese master nail artisans with Australian hospitality and stringent healthcare hygiene protocols.
about.hygieneText: Medical-grade autoclave sterilization and disposable files.
about.hygienePillar1Desc: All reusable stainless steel tools undergo thermal steam sterilization at 134°C sealed in hospital pouches.
about.hygienePillar2Desc: Nail files, buffers, pumice stones, and pedicure tub liners are discarded after every client.
about.hygienePillar3Desc: We strictly use premium cruelty-free, 10-free polishes and odorless MMA-free dipping and acrylic systems.
about.teamSubtitle: Passionate, licensed, and obsessively trained nail artists.
